paragraphs: I'm Vamsi — ECE grad who fell into computer vision, spent five years shipping production AI at a startup, filed a few patents along the way, then went back to grad school to turn hard-won intuition into rigorous method.

Currently an MS in Robotics at UMN, working across the perception-to-action loop: how robots see the world in 3D, how they act on what they see, and how well a simulated physics model has to be before you can trust it.
passions: 3D perception — turning pixels into a scene a robot can act on
Robot manipulation — closing the loop from what it sees to what it does
Physics-informed simulation — sim-to-real that survives contact with reality
Edge AI — making it all run on hardware that fits on a drone
